title: AskMyDoc
description: Built a RAG-based PDF question-answering assistant for people working through long documents, focused on grounded answers with page-level context.
details: Built a FastAPI backend with semantic search over document pages and a custom ReAct-style reasoning loop to answer questions with document context.

title: NAASH
shortDescription: AI-powered terminal shell for developer workflows.
description: Built an AI-powered terminal shell for developers working in command-line workflows, focused on natural-language command execution and error inspection.
details: Built a shell interface that lets developers use natural language to run commands, inspect errors, and work faster in the terminal.

title: HTTP Server
shortDescription: HTTP server built from scratch in Go.
description: Built an HTTP server from scratch for backend engineers learning protocol internals, focused on request parsing, headers, content length, and chunked responses.
details: Implemented request parsing, headers, content-length handling, and basic chunked responses to understand backend protocol internals.

title: Compiler
shortDescription: Small compiler built to learn language internals.
description: Built a small compiler for systems learners exploring language implementation, focused on parsing, code generation, and low-level compiler mechanics.
details: Implemented a compact compiler project to understand compiler theory through parsing, lowering, generated output, and command-line build workflows.
